title: An uppercase *served* reference hash must not report `reference-changed`
why: `ServeDesignReferenceStore` lowercases a reference hash to validate it and then serves the original spelling, so raw string inequality reports 'the design moved' for a reference that never changed. Both sides are lowercased before comparison. Its sibling fixture — an uppercase *recorded* hash — must be `schema-invalid`, because we can refuse two spellings of our own fields even though we cannot constrain what upstream publishes.
